item.title: PN remembers Raymond Caruana 39 years after murder
item.description: Nationalist leader Alex Borg stressed the importance of remembering past injustices to ensure they are not repeated

item.title: Umbrellas now proposed instead of canopy at Suq tal-Belt
item.description: Arkadia has submitted a new planning application to install six large umbrellas, to cover its outdoor dining area in front of the iconic Suq tal-Belt

item.title: Donation does not exonerate social security recipient from explaining how money was used
item.description: ​The Social Security Department must be certain that a cash donation was not used by an applicant to be eligible for medical assistance that is means tested

item.title: Public consultation on new organ transplant system launched, as opt-out proposal is scrapped
item.description: Health Minister Jo Etienne Abela says that an opt-out system simply wouldn’t increase organ transplants as much as donations after circulatory death

item.title: 2026 FIFA World Cup: Minnows and giants know their groups
item.description: Teams competing in next year's World Cup have been drawn in 12 groups • 2026 World Cup will see record 48 teams • Football's premier tournament will be hosted by Mexico, Canada and the US

item.title: Student council, administration speak of schools positive environment after shocking stabbing
item.description: The school reminded that its student council constantly works to make students’ lives more fun, adding that staff and students must rebuild the atmosphere that they slowly built over the years

item.title: Police to charge two men, woman behind gambling outlet robbery
item.description: They are believed to have fled the scene carrying cash last week

item.title: Zammit Lewis repeats call for Malta to withdraw from Eurovision to protest Israels participation
item.description: The PL MP noted that Malta should boycott the Eurovision as it makes no sense, 'to go and sing with those who represent a country exercising aggression not only on Hamas, but on women and children'

item.title: Żabbars PN local councillors stress their opposition to controversial elderly home
item.description: The PN councillors criticised the Planning Authority for disregarding the local council’s objections, claiming this showed how local councils have become 'little more than a formality' in planning procedures despite being closest to communities

item.title: Żabbar elderly home: Developer says his project will not surpass tallest building in the square
item.description: The developer also promised that no future attempts will be made to add extra floors, adding that they are prepared to enter into a contractual agreement to ensure this
